errors: No mathematical errors, since there is no mathematics.

Minor bookkeeping inconsistencies between the lists. The ink list gives '3 Stück Tischdrell 20, 29, 10'. The checklist instead splits these into 20 Ellen drill 'zu Servietten' and 29 and 10 Ellen 'zu Tischtuch'.
The 30-Ellen piece is relabelled: 'Bettlakenleinen' is struck out in the ink list, yet 'Bettlakenleinen' is retained in the checklist.
The 40-Ellen kitchen-towel drill of the ink list seems to reappear as an overwritten entry ('[40?] Ellen selbstgesponnener Handtuchdrell') in the checklist.

transcription_corrections: '7 Stück handgemachtes Leinen' more likely reads 'hausmachenes/hausgemachtes Leinen'. The checklist's struck-out 'handgespon.' is replaced by 'selbstgesponnenes'.
In the right column the struck-out quantity before 'Ellen selbstgesponnener Handtuchdrell' is probably '40', not '20'. This matches the 40-Ellen towel drill of the ink list.

The checklist line 'Ellen selbstgesponnener Drell zu Servietten' reads 'zu Servietten' with 'Servietten' written beneath. In the following line 'Servietten' is struck out and replaced by 'Tischtuch', as transcribed.
The word above '2 St. Küchenhandtücherdrell' (transcribed 'feinere[?]') is uncertain from the image and may be a different qualifier.

In '1 ungewaschenes Damastgedeck', the '20 Ellen' in the left column belongs to the line above (the blue-and-white checked linen: 30 Ellen and 20 Ellen). The damask set itself is 5 1/2 Ellen, although the checklist groups '20 Ellen 5 1/2 Ellen' under the damask entry.
